ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, flat wilted-looking leaves with visible lighter central veins, spread in a loose mound covering roughly 25-30% of the plate's area, about 9 cm across and 1.5 cm tall, slightly moist with no sheen, sitting on the left-center of the plate | 60
ITEM 2 | Thin orange shredded strands, matte, scattered across the greens, each strand about 3-5 cm long and 2 mm thick, looks like shredded carrot | 8
ITEM 3 | Whole small red cherry tomatoes, glossy smooth skin, three visible at the left edge of the greens, each about 2 cm in diameter and round | 25
ITEM 4 | Fresh red strawberries, halved and whole pieces, glossy red with white-tinged tops, roughly 3-4 cm long wedges, about 1.5-2 cm tall, clustered to the right of the greens covering about 10% of the plate | 55
ITEM 5 | Small dark blue berries, glossy skin with a small crown at the top, about 1 cm in diameter, scattered in a cluster on the right edge of the plate covering about 7% of the plate, some resting on top of the strawberries | 30
